title: GPT-6 Astra Costs More—So How Can It Be Cheaper? #Shorts
description:
GPT-6 Astra costs $50 per million output tokens versus $20 for GPT-5.6 Sol. But OpenAI says Astra used substantially fewer output tokens in several evaluations, lowering its estimated API cost per task despite the higher rate. Here is the math—and the 272K-context pricing catch.

Sources:
